# docs(hfp-021): update the project brief to the hosted-first scope

## Task

`notes/project-brief.md` still describes the original local-first V1: zero data transfer, Whisper transcription and diarization, IndexedDB storage of video blobs, and a vector engine. ADRs 0001 to 0005 replaced most of that. CLAUDE.md points readers at the brief for product context, so it should describe the product as it is now planned.

## Parent Story

Hosted-first pivot (ADR 0001).

## Blocked by

Nothing.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Vision, architecture and workflow sections match ADRs 0001 to 0005: own API and EU Postgres, text transcripts (audio deferred), in-browser analysis behind `AnalysisProvider`, and the data model.
- [ ] Removed or deferred features (transcription, diarization, vault, vector search) are either removed or listed under "Later", with a link to the ADR.
- [ ] The privacy promise is restated to match ADR 0001 (data stored only in our EU-hosted API and Postgres; transcripts never sent to a model provider).

## Suggested label

`ready-for-agent` (owner reviews)
